title: Thingiverse - Porsche 993 HiFi speaker grille frames
notes: The primary page identifies Garagefab, describes 993 HiFi grille frames for 4x6 speakers, and explicitly links https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. It warns about automatic scaling and asks users to verify scale. The Files tab lists speaker-grill-left.stl and speaker-grill-right.stl. Both were downloaded after the licence read and retained outside Git. The linked report verifies their hashes, binary structure and raw coordinate extents with two readbacks; it does not verify a physical unit, corrected scale, calibrated dimensions or vehicle fit. Same asset as SRC-RENN3D-HIFI-SPEAKER-ADAPTER-FRAMES: count once. No rescaling, repair, functional CAD, print or physical test was performed. Scale unresolved; excluded from use pending an authoritative unit/scale and independent interface evidence.
